bibl.title: Ptolemaic Officials and Officers in Search of Fame.
bibl.seg: Christelle Fischer-Bovet, Ptolemaic Officials and Officers in Search of Fame.
Riemer A. Faber (ed.), Celebrity, Fame, and Infamy in the Hellenistic World = Phoenix. Supplementary Volumes. 58 (Toronto, 2020) pp. 111-134, figg.
bibl.note: Analyses, through the interplay between individuals and communities and between statues and inscriptions, the development of the conception of fame under the Ptolemies. - 1. Introduction. - 2. International Fame, or How to Become a "Supra-polis Player". - 3. Fame in the Third Century Egyptian Context: Elite Self-Representation. - 4. Fame in the Second Century: A Transition. - 5. Fame in the First Century BCE. - 6. Conclusion.
